items.name: Beeplus
items.challenge: The challenge was delivering a high-quality design within a tight timeline while capturing the client's vision of a bold, colorful, and visually engaging Dribbble-inspired aesthetic.
items.approach: With a clear client reference, I analyzed its typography, colors, and layout direction. Within four days, I delivered the complete landing page along with its responsive version.

items.name: Mercedes F1
items.challenge: Main challenge of this case study is how we change approach of existing static website to dynamic motion website using the f1 car part as the main key visual.
items.approach: We decide to use the car and also it's part to be our main key visual and then we apply i through all of the website section using hover, scroll and also website interaction.

items.name: Enso
items.challenge: The challenge is enso want to create a fresh traditional finance concept website and transition from crypto glow dark mode concept which is completely different.

items.name: Arcania
items.challenge: The man challenge of this case study is how can we bring "Interior design" to become our main visual approach, either the layout, font and also the interaction.
items.approach: We use the approach of interior by applying ruler as a grid representation, all of our section is using line grid and same view height to respresent that all of this section website feels like designed in interior approach.

items.name: Wegonorth
items.challenge: The client wants a website that incorporates a narrative or objects that representing "Wegonorth" and highlights their company motto "moving forward."
items.approach: I decide to use compass as the main key visual for this website, the compas movement is applied on entire website including scroll animation and hover interaction.

items.name: Lexur
items.challenge: The main challenge is create a dark glow crypto website vibes without making it looks overwhelmed, so basically combined the glow dark mode and simplicity at the same time with only 2 days timeline.
